messages:
maria-ml: FYI opened PR #4827 — touches serving/configs/* and docs/guide/serving.md. CODEOWNERS currently only lists /runtime/* and /docs/*; looks like serving/configs isn't covered. who can approve this?

jon-platform: pinging @kevin-oncall and @ashley-docs. my read is eng-platform should own serving/configs but agree we need to be explicit. cc eng-runtime?

ashley-docs: I can sign off on the docs change once runtime/config owners ok the config edits. small wording nit in guide, i'll push as a followup if needed.

kevin-oncall: oncall usually rubber-stamps emergency patches, not config ownership. this isn't urgent. we should get eng-runtime or eng-platform to approve. @maria-ml can you paste the CODEOWNERS snippet and the files changed?

maria-ml: sure, here's the relevant bits and the PR diff head:

```
# CODEOWNERS (root)
/docs/ @ashley-docs
/runtime/ @eng-runtime
# note: no explicit rule for /serving/
```

Files in PR:
- serving/configs/default.yaml
- serving/configs/qos.yaml
- docs/guide/serving.md

jon-platform: thanks. two options: 1) eng-platform adds a temporary proxy approval and we follow up with a CODEOWNERS update; 2) open small OWNERS/alias PR to add /serving/ -> @eng-platform-team. i'm happy to proxy-approve this one if it's blocking you.

maria-ml: option 1 would unblock us for deploy today. would you proxy? i can open the CODEOWNERS update PR after lunch.

jon-platform: I can proxy-approve this one. please add the label `needs-eng-platform-approval` and ping me when CI is green. i'll approve and merge. i'll also create the CODEOWNERS PR to add `/serving/ @eng-platform` and request a quick review.

ashley-docs: :+1: sounds good. i'll hold off merging docs until jon approves the config.

kevin-oncall: noted. if anything touches production runtime configs please @kevin-oncall immediately.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4827 — build 7821 — integration tests ok.

maria-ml: thanks all, adding label and pinging once CI is green. really appreciate the quick proxy. :pray:
